analyst.summary: NLC India is a government-owned lignite mining and power generation company that is now expanding into renewable energy, including a newly awarded 900 MW solar project. The core mining and power business grows slowly, and a meaningful part of this year's reported profit came from non-core other income (such as interest earnings) rather than from the core mining/power operations, so the headline profit growth overstates the underlying business's momentum somewhat. We rate it a Hold: a stable, mature PSU utility with a real but incremental renewable growth story layered on top, at earnings that include a notable non-core boost.
